Kill the [[Iron Forgeman]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill the Iron Forgeman in [[the Forge Heart]].
* *BONUS* Kill The {{sic|Unlike the previous objective, 'The' is capitalized here}} Iron Forgeman in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 30 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 75 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[The Forge Heart#Walkthrough|The Forge Heart]].
